property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, contract C always makes exactly _tos.length external transferFrom calls (one per element) to the callee; the mutant that loops to _tos.length-1 omits the final call, which a recording/reverting callee can observe and thus breaks this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the loop bound to run one fewer iteration (i < _tos.length - 1), so last recipient is not called; for inputs where length>0 this can change return if a skipped external call would have reverted.
